description: Source file implementing GPU picture buffer classes for Windows in Chromium, including EGL stream and D3D texture handling for video decoding.

classes.name: DXVAPictureBuffer
classes.description: Base class for GPU picture buffers handling different mechanisms for video decoding.

classes.name: PbufferPictureBuffer
classes.description: Derived class managing picture buffers using Pbuffer textures.

classes.name: EGLStreamPictureBuffer
classes.description: Derived class managing picture buffers with EGL streams for external textures.

classes.name: EGLStreamCopyPictureBuffer
classes.description: Derived class managing picture buffers with EGL streams for texture copying.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to create appropriate DXVAPictureBuffer subclass based on decoder mechanism.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the picture buffer with necessary EGL or D3D resources.

methods.name: CopyOutputSampleDataToPictureBuffer
methods.description: Copies decoded sample data into the picture buffer.

methods.name: ReusePictureBuffer
methods.description: Prepares the picture buffer for reuse, releasing resources.

methods.name: CopySurfaceComplete
methods.description: Completes surface copy operations, updating texture bindings.

methods.name: BindSampleToTexture
methods.description: Binds a sample to the texture for rendering or processing.
